hero.title: Dance Photography
hero.subtitle: I freeze every move — the passion, emotion and beauty of dance in a single frame.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: I am Jacek Galewicz — a photographer specializing in dance photography. For over 10 years I have accompanied dancers at competitions across Poland and Europe, capturing every emotion-filled moment of movement.
about.p2: My passion is conveying the dynamics of dance — that fleeting moment when music and movement become one. I work with professional equipment capable of capturing the fastest tempos.
about.p3: I collaborate with dancers, dance schools and competition organizers throughout Poland.
